description: Na₂LiMnCPO₇ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.76 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.69 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.89 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.65 Å. There are two inequivalent Li sites. In the first Li site, Li is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.05-2.20 Å. In the second Li site, Li is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.46 Å. There are two inequivalent Mn sites. In the first Mn site, Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.17-2.34 Å. In the second Mn site, Mn is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted MnO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.09-2.20 Å. There are two inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. All C-O bond lengths are 1.30 Å. In the second C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.30 Å) and one longer (1.31 Å) C-O bond length. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent MnO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent MnO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 52-61°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.55-1.57 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent MnO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent MnO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 43-50°. There is one shorter (1.55 Å) and three longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are fourteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Li, and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Li, one Mn, and one P atom to form distorted ONaLiMnP trigonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₂MnP tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₃MnC trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one ONaLiMnP trigonal pyramid. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, one Mn, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Li, one Mn, and one P atom to form distorted ONaLiMnP trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂MnP tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one ONaLiMnP trigonal pyramid. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Mn, and one P atom to form distorted ONa₂MnP tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₃MnC trigonal bipyramids, corners with three ONaLiMnP trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂LiC tetrahedra. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Li, one Mn, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, one Mn, and one P atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Mn, and one C atom to form distorted ONa₃MnC trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four ONa₂MnP tetrahedra and  a cornercorner with one ONaLiMnP trigonal pyramid. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mn, and one C atom. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Li, and one C atom to form distorted ONa₂LiC tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₃MnC trigonal bipyramids and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂MnP tetrahedra.
